title: Blender furnished apartment
features: Blender-authored household meshes shared by Unreal and browser
Five rooms, white walls and ceiling, traditional 30 cm terrazzo
Curved upholstery, open slippers and bowls, real shelf cavities, woven textiles
Static collision follows visible triangle surfaces; doorway layout retained
limitations: Generic model, not a scan of the user home
Furniture and textiles are static rigid surfaces; no cloth deformation or cable entanglement
Window blinds are opaque; reflective mirrors depend on renderer reflection support
Lighting and material response are approximations, not calibrated household measurements
